newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy Mexico's San Luis - LatInvest.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy Mexico's San Luis - LatInvest.

text.p: London-based Latin American brokerage LatInvest on Friday posted a "Buy" recommendation for Mexican conglomerate San Luis, saying the firm was set to benefit from the weaker peso.

"San Luis's growth prospects are impressive and given the recent weakening in the peso we would be buyers of the stock," Latin America analyst Jason Belmont said, adding the autoparts and mining conglomerate had underperformed the index by about 10 percent this year.
"San Luis stock performance has been punished in 1996 due to its high dollar revenues; the stock is up 7.0 percent over the year to date compared to 18 percent for the index," he said.
"Nevertheless it has managed to maintain superior margins despite the peso appreciation."
After consolidating all year the peso has come under pressure over the past 2-1/2 weeks, slipping by about 5.0 percent.
Because San Luis has almost 90 percent of its revenues in dollars it is now positioned to reap the benefits, Belmont said, adding it had good margins and strong growth prospects."
